description: facebook: Profile Events. GET /v1/facebook/profile/events. Get a public Facebook page's upcoming events, 8 per page, in the order Facebook lists them. total_count is the page's upcoming-event count. Pass cursor from a response, with the same url, for the next page. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous response, to get the next page of events

url.description: The URL of the public Facebook page

name: facebook_profile_events
